The Subtask Name: Identify the liberal arts college founded in 1855 from which James Fieser received his B.A.

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Conducted targeted web searches to identify James Fieser’s B.A. institution.
  -- Observation: Found conflicting claims about Fieser's B.A. institution, with some sources indicating Bates College and others suggesting Berea College.
  -- Thought: Both Bates College and Berea College were founded in 1855, so the task required a definitive source to confirm the exact institution.
  -- Result: After multiple searches, the most credible source confirmed that Fieser earned his B.A. from Bates College.
